note: LIRIL operates as a dev team with a visible work schedule. Each task is routed through a pipeline of specialist roles (researcher, architect, designer, engineer, editor) with a final gatekeeper LIRIL hallucination gate. Only PASS verdicts reach the commit stage. Public accountability: the user can see at any moment what LIRIL is working on, which tasks it has completed, and which it has flagged as not-yet-confident.

sprint.goal: Operationalize LIRIL as an autonomous dev team producing real website improvements under PASS-only commit policy. Ship one completed task per cycle minimum.
sprint.commit_policy: Every commit must (a) pass the commit-msg jargon hook, (b) receive LIRIL verdict PASS on the diff, (c) be aligned with a task from this backlog, (d) have a plain-English subject under 72 chars. No [PHASE N]. No ABCXYZ. No mass injections.

roles.researcher: Reads primary sources (Canada Gazette, Hansard, Commissioner reports, court filings) and identifies gaps or facts to be added. Outputs: a citation-backed paragraph or JSON entry.
roles.architect: Decides where in the 19-axis / IA-pillar layout a change belongs. Outputs: target filename + exact insertion point + rationale.
roles.designer: Proposes the UX/visual approach following IA best practices (Shneiderman overview-first, NN/g readability, WCAG 2.1 AA). Outputs: a brief spec.
roles.engineer: Writes the code, HTML, or JSON change. Outputs: the actual diff.
roles.editor: Copy-checks, verifies every claim has a source, checks accessibility (alt text, ARIA), confirms links resolve. Outputs: edited diff + fix list.
roles.gatekeeper: LIRIL hallucination gate via mercury.infer. Demands VERDICT: PASS|WATCH|FAIL + REASON. PASS required for commit. WATCH or FAIL sends task back to research.

backlog.title: Add LIRIL audit badge to enforcement-followthrough.html cards
backlog.acceptance: Each finding in data/enforcement_followthrough.json gains a top-level note field 'audit_visible: true' so the rendering code in enforcement-followthrough.html can gate whether to show the LIRIL verdict badge.
backlog.context: Layer-4 officer findings already show LIRIL verdict badges. Layer-5 does not. First fully six-role autonomous task to prove cross-page consistency.

backlog.title: Add reader_guidance to data/officer_of_parliament_findings.json
backlog.acceptance: Add a top-level key reader_guidance (dict) with how_to_read and what_to_verify string fields — matching the pattern already added to data/enforcement_followthrough.json by WS-009. Parallel enrichment for consistency between layers.
backlog.context: WS-009 shipped this pattern for Layer 5. Replicating for Layer 4 keeps the two layers symmetrical.

backlog.title: Audit + fix of sibling visualization pages identified by the explore agent
backlog.acceptance: Each page gets (a) a plain-English 'what you are looking at' explainer at the top, (b) distinct categorical colors (not all crimson), (c) a top-N-by-default view for dense datasets, (d) removal of auto-generated 'tnt-style-XXXX' class pollution.
backlog.context: The network-analysis.html fix in commit 75da91c8 addressed one page of this class. The explore-agent audit on 2026-04-17 found five more with similar UX failures.

backlog.title: Add primary-source URL to every row in data/grover_target_campaigns.json
backlog.acceptance: Every campaign entry has at least one primary_source URL pointing to Canada.ca, parl.gc.ca, oag-bvg.gc.ca, pbo-dpb.gc.ca, or court filings. Any entry without one is marked source_pending and flagged for follow-up.
backlog.context: A corrections-transparency audit in the press-kit already surfaced two hallucinations in this file (CSC $60B->$77B, fabricated Carbon Report 2021). The preventive fix is making every row cite-or-die.

backlog.title: Cross-reference Commissioner of Lobbying monthly communication reports with accountability_inflections.json dates
backlog.acceptance: For each of the 7 cabinet-shuffle inflection dates, list organizations that had registered lobbying communications with the affected ministerial portfolios in the 90-day windows before and after. Provides empirical answer to 'who was in the room when portfolios changed hands'.
backlog.context: OSINT layers 3 and 4 showed the when + what-found. Lobbying Registry monthly reports are the who-was-registered-in-the-room. This is the natural next OSINT layer.

backlog.title: Add reader_guidance to data/accountability_inflections.json
backlog.acceptance: Add a top-level key reader_guidance (dict) with how_to_read and what_to_verify string fields. Same shape as WS-009 and WS-011.

backlog.title: Add cross_layer_references to Layer 5 summary

backlog.title: Add net_outcome_rationale field to each Layer-5 finding
backlog.acceptance: For each finding in data/enforcement_followthrough.json, add a net_outcome_rationale string field (one sentence) explaining WHY that finding was categorized as no_enforcement / regulatory_change / civil_suit / criminal_investigation / judicial_review.
backlog.context: Makes the net_outcome categorization transparent to reviewers rather than opaque.

backlog.title: Backfill primary_source URL on each enforcement chronology entry
backlog.acceptance: Every chronology entry within every finding gains a source_url field pointing to the specific court judgment, committee report, or news-of-record URL underpinning that event. If a source is not confidently available, set source_url to null and source_pending to true.
backlog.context: Raises the evidentiary density of Layer 5 — every dated event becomes independently verifiable.

backlog.title: Migrate enhancement bar features (speed, autoplay, captions, transcript) into liril-walkthrough.js
backlog.acceptance: Speed multiplier, autoplay, closed-captions, transcript panel are reachable from the single unified walkthrough UI. localStorage keys from __LIRIL_WT_PREF_KEYS preserved so user preferences migrate cleanly.
backlog.context: Commit 2a4d858c neutralized walkthrough-enhancements.js to collapse the duplicate purple bar into a single UI. The deferred work is porting the useful features of that file into the one surviving walkthrough module.

backlog.title: Add visibility of the LIRIL hallucination gate to every page that cites findings
backlog.acceptance: Each page that presents factual findings shows the LIRIL audit verdict (PASS/WATCH/FAIL) inline on each claim or a summary block linking to the audit JSON. Users can see at-a-glance whether the on-GPU gate signed off.
backlog.context: officer-of-parliament-findings.html already does this after commit c34550bf. Extending the pattern to the other fact-heavy pages makes the entire investigation auditable.

backlog.title: Add generated_at_utc to data/liril_work_schedule.json

backlog.context: Minor schema uniformity — other data files have both generated_at and updated_at; the work schedule only has updated_at.
